No, a few bent leaves and loose soil are considered normal in transit and don't count as damage under our DOA policy.

DOA means things like a snapped main stem, a cracked or smashed pot, exposed roots, or a dead or severely wilted plant. If you see any of those, report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box, and we'll send a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or refund you.

If the plant later declines (for example, loses more than a third of its leaves or develops stem or root rot), you can file a claim under our 30-day Plant Care Guarantee from "My Orders" with at least two photos.
